regions.full_page: John Coneff (one-time successful insurance and business- man .... founder of the"Cath'c Beneficial Society.") wonders where he'l get $175 to pay monthly rental ... Raised $300.00 six yrs ago on house- furniture - at 32% per month. = 42% per annum! (gave him 30c for Gass) and supply of bread.
